supported_claims: The response aggregation supplies nNO and nYES to the pooled-proportion test from the same response collection.
The inspected denominator is sqrt(p*(1-p)*2/n), with p=(nNO+nYES)/(2*n).
The PC-style interface converts the decision to 0 or 1.
